title: Could be used for a door mat.
text:
Could be used for a door mat.. Not only did my rug came in with the sides fraid in red, and damage, the colors looked like there smeared together.
The rug is Very thin and rough, and the back will slide around on wood, and laminate floors unless you use a rubber mat underneath,
Or use over your carpet. But it might put wear on your carpet!

This could be used as a door mat.

The picture does not look like what you get..it is half that size with one design , not two.
I do not ever remember giving a one star before..

product_metadata.title: Loloi II Nour Area Rug 1'-6"" X 1'-6"" Square Blue/Fiesta (NU-03)
features: The stylish contemporary designs from our Nour collection exquisitely combine durability, affortability, and fashion forward design.

Durable in construction, the Nour collection is power loomed of polypropylene and offers long life, maintaining its texture, color, and overall beauty for years to come. With it's low pile this rug guarantees low maintenance and easy cleaning.
The traditionally-inspired designs from the Nour collection effortlessly blend timeless motifs with contemporary design, easily reinvigorating and elevating your décor space.
Featuring a ivory color base with tangerine, dark red, denim, and sky blue design accents.
These power loomed designs are intricately crafted using cutting edge technology that allows for durability and detail that can't be replicated by hand. Rug pad recommended to prevent slipping.
description: A modern foundation for any room. Thanks to a 100% polypropylene pile, the Nour rug doesn’t shed and will remain colorfast and stain-resistant in even your busiest space. Plus, the patterns are artfully distressed for a lived-in feel, ensuring added character from the moment its unrolled. Power-loomed in Turkey.

details.Special Feature: Kid & Pet Friendly, stain resistant, the Nour Collection is perfect for any family with easy cleaning and maintenance, With maximum durability, the Nour Collection does not shed and can sustain moderate traffic in most indoor spaces, With multiple colors and patterns to choose from, the Nour Collection can renew a variety of rooms and spaces, The Nour Collection comes in multiple sizes to fit any room or space design, With top of the line power loomed, machine-woven technology, the Nour collection offers equisite design at maximum value
